rule: One row per field of SPEC section 6. Every row either has a value with provenance, or is null with a blockedReason and an explicit blocks[] list naming the work it stops. A null row blocks ONLY the work in its blocks[] list; it never blocks unrelated work that already has its inputs.

firstTask.value: segmentation, CPU, single feature slot features.pre_pool, module chain built from pinned module ids
firstTask.provenance: docs/mvp/phases/PHASE2-FREEZE-CHECKLIST.md section 1 option 甲 (manual proposal over the two ready modules) combined with PHASE2-SPEC section 5 (first profile adds compileRecipe/prepareRun/verifyRun for ONE task)

value.topology: Conv2d(3->8,k=3,p=1) -> ReLU -> features.pre_pool -> AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1)) -> flatten -> Linear(8,2)
value.note: This is the repository's own pinned baseline source, not an upstream official implementation. It is recorded as an offline_archive pin by content hash rather than as a vcs commit, because this repository has no per-file commit pin for it and inventing one would be a false provenance claim.

baseline.provenance: experiments/stitch-cpu-v1/model.py read from disk and hashed in this session; weights file hashed in this session; fixtures/modules/manifest.json declares the matching [4,8,16,16] float32 module contract

modules.provenance: fixtures/modules/manifest.json (ids, names, mechanism, implementationHash) and fixtures/papers/manifest.json (paper identity, locator, documentHash); both re-hashed from disk in this session. The implementationHash in the manifest matches the sha256 of the file on disk.
notClaimed: Neither module is the paper's official implementation. Both are this repository's own 8-channel reimplementations, exactly as docs/mvp/phases/PHASE2-DATA-REQUEST.md section 1.2 states. The provenance recorded here is the PAPER identity plus a local implementation hash, not an upstream code pin.
Both modules declare mechanismKind parameterized_feature, which is the class the mechanism check engine keys on. No P6 interventionAxis label is used to place either module.

value.testSplitReason: PHASE2-SPEC section 2/3 declares no test split for Phase 2; a test handle belongs to the Phase 3 DataSplitManifest.

profileRuntimeData.note: The pinned runner currently consumes dataSpec.kind='synthetic' generated in-process from (seed, sampleCount, shape, numClasses). The .npy slice above is the recorded, hash-pinned slice for the same generator parameters. A run that needs to read the .npy files directly requires a runner change, which is NOT part of this profile.

data.provenance: fixtures/phase2-source-pack/data/data-manifest.json read from disk; the four .npy files re-hashed in this session and matching the manifest

dataLicense.provenance: The slice is generated by fixtures/phase2-source-pack/data/generate_data.py from numpy PCG64 with seed 20261004. It is not redistributed third-party data, so no third-party data licence applies.
notClaimed: This licence statement covers ONLY the synthetic slice. It says nothing about the two module implementations, which carry licenseRef no-license-declared, and nothing about any upstream paper's code.

codeLicense.blockedReason: No LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING or NOTICE file exists at the repository root and no licence file is tracked by git (verified by directory listing and `git ls-files`). The two module implementations and the baseline are therefore repository-internal code with no declared licence. docs/mvp/phases/PHASE2-DATA-REQUEST.md section 1.5 requires the honest value here to be no-license-declared, recorded as unresolved, and explicitly forbids inventing a licence name to fill the field.
codeLicense.verifiedOn: 2026-10-04, re-checked independently of the worker that first wrote this row: a recursive listing for LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT outside node_modules returned nothing, and `git remote -v` returned empty, so there is no upstream to cite either. The null therefore rests on a re-runnable check, not on an assumption; re-run both commands to confirm it still holds.
blocks: ANY redistribution, publication or external hand-off of the module or baseline source, including attaching it to a paper artifact
ANY claim that the pinned code is reusable by a third party
replacing the repository-internal module implementations with upstream official code (that replacement needs a real upstream licence pin, which does not exist yet)
doesNotBlock: running the profile inside this repository for engineering validation
the smoke and tiny runs, which stay on this machine
mechanism checks, which read the local files only

profileAndDevice.provenance: configs/phase2/profile-cpu-seg-v1.json (validated against the frozen TaskProfile contract by scripts/verify-phase2-profile.ts) and configs/phase2/environment-cpu-seg-v1.json (measured in this session)
notClaimed: maxModules=3 matches the frozen P6 v1 cap. The v2 contract raises the cap to 8 but is opt-in and is NOT this profile's contract; this profile refuses a 4-module binding rather than silently accepting it.
GPU execution is not supported. A manifest declaring any device other than cpu is refused at preflight with PREFLIGHT_DEVICE_MISMATCH.

patchProvider.provenance: docs/mvp/phases/PHASE2-FREEZE-CHECKLIST.md section 1 option 甲 recommends the manual path for the first round; PHASE2-SPEC section 6 leaves human vs agent open, so this row records the first round's choice rather than a permanent decision.

agentPath.detail: The interface accepts patchProvider 'agent' and the adaptation plan can declare it. This row does not authorise an agent patch for the first round: no agent patch provider has been reviewed for the allowed-path policy yet.
blocks: an agent-generated patch entering adaptImplementation in round one

value.separation: The source checkout is read-only and the patch workspace is a copy under work/research-execution/<taskId>/. packages/evolver/src/domain/patch-workspace.ts asserts the two roots are disjoint.

allowedFiles.provenance: docs/mvp/phases/PHASE2-SPEC.md sections 5 and 6, plus the DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_PATHS list already implemented in packages/evolver/src/domain/adaptation-plan.ts. The allowed set is deliberately narrow: one workspace subtree, so an adaptation cannot touch the evaluator, the pinned sources, the check rules or the configuration table.

value.rule: Only the packages already installed and recorded in configs/phase2/environment-cpu-seg-v1.json may be used. Adding a dependency is not permitted by this policy: it requires a new lock file and a re-run of the profile and mechanism checks, which is a separate decision.

dependencies.provenance: configs/phase2/environment-cpu-seg-v1.json packageLock closure (384 packages, digest d8315f3a5da468066b4e9d6798d17bbd9fcf9d6cebd3002ec5c16bf2d1fc17f0) and the import list read from experiments/phase2-cpu-seg-v1/runner.py
notClaimed: The dependency closure is a computed digest of what is installed, not a checked-in lock file. No requirements.txt, environment.yml or JS lock file exists in the repository root. Drift is detectable; a fresh-machine reproduction is not proven.

isolationBackend.provenance: configs/phase2/isolation-policy.json, enforced and negative-tested by scripts/verify-phase2-profile.ts
notClaimed: This is not an OS sandbox, not a container, and not a network jail. It constrains the paths THIS host code will read, write or hand to a child process. It does not stop an arbitrary already-running program.
Network isolation is not provided by the policy. The pinned runner imports no network module, which is a property of the pinned runner, not of the isolation backend.

mechanismChecks.provenance: packages/evolver/src/domain/mechanism-checks.ts: the required rule set is fixed in code and loadMechanismCheckProfile rejects a profile that omits or invents a rule; the tolerance table in configs/phase2/tolerances.json was generated from MECHANISM_TOLERANCES_V1 so it cannot drift from the engine.

unavailableKinds.note: The engine implements all six MECHANISM_KINDS. This profile's pinned module chain only exercises two of them. A module of an unimplemented-for-this-profile kind is reported blocked by the check engine, never silently passed.

value.wallClockDeadlineNote: An absolute UTC deadline is a scheduling decision the caller supplies per request; this table pins the per-attempt and total ceilings below and does not invent a calendar date.

budget.provenance: configs/phase2/budget-measurement.json: six real child-process runs of the pinned runner on this machine in this session, peak working set sampled every 10 ms
notClaimed: The measurements are from this machine and this CPU path; they are not a cross-machine performance claim.
maxModelCalls=0 records that this profile performs no model call. It is not a statement that a future Phase 2 profile may not need one.

tolerances.provenance: Generated from MECHANISM_TOLERANCES_V1 in packages/evolver/src/domain/mechanism-checks.ts in this session, so the config and the engine cannot drift. Each entry carries dtype plus abs/rel/min bounds or an explicit exact/count comparison rule, and a rationale string.
notClaimed: No entry is a silent default: an entry with no numeric bound is declared 'exact' or 'count', which is a comparison rule, not a tolerance.

value.appliesTo: a same-input rerun of the pinned runner under the same seed, recipe and environment
value.evidence: The pinned runner is deterministic by construction: torch.set_num_threads(1), torch.manual_seed(seed), torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) where supported, a fixed batch order (step % numBatches) and no dropout or augmentation. Two ab/5-step runs in this session produced identical initialLoss and finalLoss to the last printed digit (0.754048 -> 0.749849).

rerunTolerance.provenance: configs/phase2/budget-measurement.json rows tiny-ab-5 and tiny-ab-5-rerun (identical loss start/end), plus the values EVAL.md section 1 already fixes for clean replay (atol 1e-6, rtol 1e-5)
